# has metric kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasMetricKind`](gmeow-hasMetricKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMetricKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The distance or dissimilarity metric declared by this reference frame. Functional: a frame uses exactly one metric kind for all proximity computations expressed in it. The actual computation is performed by the solver ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), never materialised as asserted triples in the OWL core.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the distance/dissimilarity metric a frame uses for all proximity computations; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid materialising computed distances as triples (the solver computes, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:MetricKind`](../classes/gmeow-MetricKind.md) individual; [`gmeow:ProximityMeasurement`](../classes/gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md) values in this frame are resolved by the solver using it.
